set.body:
Phase: core. Track: engine. Small.

Why
The 18 November audit reproduced a loop. A valid BIDS draft prepared against an accepted archive is told to reassess. After reassessing and accepting, it is told the same again.

Acceptance
1. The loop is reproduced in a test.
2. The attempt ends with one clear outcome that says what to do: deposit the curated BIDS study as its own dataset. The documentation says the same.
3. Reassessment of unchanged content, and ordinary additions of the same kind, still pass.

Not in scope
Linking the BIDS result to its source archive. That is the rest of PRO03, parked.

Start from (line references from the audit at b82cd14)
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/NativeRepository.scala line 162.
- modules/bids/src/main/scala/sanctity/bids/DatasetInterpreter.scala line 10.
set.title: CORE6: Turning an accepted archive into BIDS gives a truthful outcome
